purpose: One predeclared text-routed Local/Global/DRIFT method compared with BM25, Microsoft Basic and hybrid; no per-query oracle or three-strategy cross product.
routing: routing_rules.route(query), ordered deterministic regex; unknown classification falls back to Local; failures do not trigger another route.

budget.note: Worst transient bound assumes two extra attempts for every logical generation/embedding request. Common-input64k is a hard cumulative per-question-method cap; repeated transient failures may exhaust it before all stages finish. Such failures remain in denominators. Provider-reported input may differ; requested output2048 is known not to be enforced by this proxy, so no total-generation-dollar guarantee.

generation_model: gpt-5.6-luna via existing approved provider; backend identity not independently verified
embedding_model: text-embedding-3-large,3072 dimensions via existing approved provider
prompt_policy: Append the same supplied-snapshot-only evidence restriction to every generation subcall. HyDE/intermediate answers are synthetic search material, never raw source evidence. No gold, rubric, hidden tests, prior answers or scores sent to models.

randomness.hyde_template: Replace only primer.secrets reference with a deterministic choice selecting minimum sha256(seed:raw_query:report_id). Save report ID and hash. No gold or result access.
randomness.followups: Use a dedicated random.Random seeded from seed and raw question per search for state.random.shuffle; preserve upstream shuffle behavior. PYTHONHASHSEED fixed before process startup.

accounting: Carry forward1349 generation reservations,1977136 common-input tokens,658211 embedding tokens and103 current-ledger embedding attempts. Do not alter prior index ledger.
Count all actual attempts and every new administrative reservation; requested1883 includes no extra hidden probes or reservations.
Report provider usage separately from common-token input; unknown usage is unknown, never0.
Save every actual stage prompt/response, context tables, source provenance and timestamp; suppress credentials and private filesystem paths.
All retries count against per-request, per-question-method and cumulative caps.
failure_policy: At most two additional attempts per same request for previously authorized transient classes; preserve successful reply/cache and never resend it. Deterministic minimal syntax-only repair may reuse a complete reply with original/diff/schema audit, no missing fields or semantic repairs. Budget/schema/semantic failures remain in denominators; no post-result routing or unlimited retries.
evaluation: Answer necessary-point0/.5/1, equal weight per question; source/citation support, specific errors and unsupported assertions separate.
Separate raw-source evidence union over actual read stages from final-generation raw-source context. Intermediate text/report descriptions are not source evidence.
Track actual calls,input/output,all context/source tokens and unique source rows,wall latency and failure rate per question/method.
Main20 test/dev separate. Supplement6 separate; overlapping new answers reused,old experimental answers not mixed.
No feature patches or tests in this round; planning results do not measure implementation success.
Failure with no final answer gets0 answer coverage and explicit failed status; partial retrieval footprint may be reported separately.
limitations: Previously seen questions and prior-result-aware researchers; route fixed before new results,not a new blinded benchmark.
Equal64k total common-input ceiling is not equal actual spend; single-round baselines may use less.
Limited DRIFT parameters and deterministic randomness adapters are explicit deviations from defaults; no claim of default-DRIFT or static-call-graph completeness.
Official DRIFT can rank/shuffle incomplete actions across all pending branches; two epochs are not guaranteed two-hop traversal.
Shared proxy may exceed requested output2048; no hard total-output or generation-dollar guarantee.
